Two strips of cooked bacon, which look thin and well done. Cooked bacon runs about 40-50 kcal per slice, or roughly 8 g per slice. These strips look twisted and fairly long, so about 2 slices at about 8 g each gives 16 g, and about 45 kcal per slice gives about 90 kcal. Since they look thin and crispy, I'll settle slightly lower.
